sections.html:
• Origin: North America
  • Growth rate: slow
  • Height: 20-30+ cm (average after two months in the tank)
  • Light demand: low
  • CO2 demand: low

Bacopa caroliniana has few demands and is thus very convenient for beginners. Its slow growth rate makes it one of the few stem plants that do not need much attention. Like most stem plants, it is most decorative when planted in small groups. It is easy to propagate by cuttings: take a side shoot and plant it in the bottom.
Bacopa caroliniana originates from the US and has been used as an aquarium plant for many years. Stems become 10-30 cm long and 3-4 cm wide, branching willingly from the bottom.
